_note: Experiment arms. Each is the frozen baseline config plus the listed overrides, so every arm differs from the baseline in a stated, minimal way. 'subset' restricts an arm to the tasks where its mechanism can act.

baseline.description: Frozen baseline: the main 4B model makes every decision generatively; incremental review; FIFO model queue.

batch_review.description: Manager waits for the whole batch before reviewing (what the WebSwarm reference code does), instead of reviewing each arrival.

probing.description: Web probing before WIDE planning (WebSwarm section 3.3).

finish_first.description: Model-slot scheduler serves calls that complete a node before calls that start new work.

rules.description: All bounded decisions (route, next ATOM action, review, verify-or-not, redundancy) by deterministic rules; no model calls for control.

local_s1_4b.description: Bounded decisions as typed one-token questions answered by the same 4B model via logprobs (local System One-style).

local_s1_2b.description: Same typed decisions answered by the smaller qwen3.5:2b model; research still by the 4B model.
